messages:
maria_fin: Noting a west-eu spot fallback event overnight that drove a 3.2k delta. Raw query attached. Thinking we need a one-off adjustment and a tighter fallback rule.

luke_platform: I saw the autoscaler logs too. It flipped from spot -> on-demand at 02:05Z for ~90 minutes while capacity rebalanced. A handful of long-running eval jobs retried without backoff.

anita_ml: Those eval jobs are from the recommendations team; they had max_retries=5 and immediate retry configured in their dag. They should change to exponential backoff.

maria_fin: Aggregated by owner team (source CSV): recommendations 1,600 (9.4h extra), scoring 700 (3.5h), playground 400 (1.8h).

owen_eng: Proposed finance rule for spot-fallback incidents: if preemption count > 50 in 2h AND fallback_to_on_demand=true then finance credits 40% of incremental GPU cost to affected teams; platform absorbs 60% from contingency.

luke_platform: I support 40%. Also propose immediate follow-up: update templates to include retry-with-backoff and limit retries for non-critical jobs.

maria_fin: Vote check: @owen_eng approve? @luke_platform approve?

owen_eng: Approve. :white_check_mark:
luke_platform: Approve. :white_check_mark:

maria_fin: Filing adjustment now. Will assign credits pro-rata by incremental hours and include note: "spot fallback incident 2Q2026 partial credit".

billing-bot: Created adjustment ticket BILL-4892. Credited amount: 1,280 (40% of 3.2k). Link: https://internal.tools/billing/tickets/BILL-4892

maria_fin: Action items: 1) Platform to push updated job templates with backoff (owner: luke_platform). 2) Dev teams to audit retry settings for evals (owner: anita_ml). 3) Finance to update incident-credit playbook with the 40/60 rule (owner: maria_fin). I'll message teams with the breakdown and close the loop. Thanks everyone.
